remaining_tasks.name: Fix Edit Metadata dialog save — PATCH request never reaches backend
remaining_tasks.note: Zero PATCH logs on backend. Three bugs identified: (A) PATCH request never sent — likely a JS exception in save() or wrong URL; check browser DevTools Network tab for the PATCH request. (B) No afterClosed() handler on dialog.open() in dashboard.component.ts line 1523 — stale cache/UI after save even if save works. (C) Clearing a field sends v='' which is filtered out by save(), backend never deletes the row — need backend DELETE or send null and handle deletion.

decisions.decision: metadata_field_values for language fields use xx_XX locale codes (id_ID not id)
decisions.rationale: Autofill stores locale codes; mat-select requires exact value match. scoring_job.py converts xx_XX→xx-XX via .replace() before sending to BrainSuite API.

Was a pre-existing feature; needs connection_metadata_defaults table + account config UI + lookup fallback. See memory file.
